gcp.lb.internal.data_processed.note: Internal Application Load Balancers: requests and responses processed (per GiB). From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.lb.internal.proxy_instance.note: Internal Application Load Balancers (regional and cross-region): each managed Envoy proxy instance, at least three per INTERNAL_MANAGED forwarding rule; one instance handles 18 MB/s or 1,400 requests a second. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.psc.data_processed.note: Private Service Connect consumer data processing to a published service, inbound and outbound (per GiB), the first PiB of the billing account a month (then $0.006, from 5 PiB $0.004). Endpoints to Google APIs have no data charge. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set. The service id and filter are unchecked.

gcp.psc.endpoint_hour.note: Each Private Service Connect endpoint (a forwarding rule with an empty load balancing scheme), to a published service or to Google APIs, an hour. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set. The service id and filter are unchecked.
